title: Practice Set — Physical Quantities & Dimensions
notes:
Q1. Which of these is a fundamental quantity: force, velocity, temperature, work?
Answer: Temperature

Q2. The dimensional formula of force is:
Answer: [M L T⁻²]

Q3. The dimensional formula of power is:
Answer: [M L² T⁻³]

Q4. The number of significant figures in 0.00450 is:
Answer: 3 (leading zeros are not significant; the '45' and trailing zero are)

Q5. Relative error is defined as:
Answer: (mean absolute error) ÷ (mean value)

Q6. By the principle of homogeneity, addition is allowed only between:
Answer: quantities of the same dimensions

Q7. The dimensional formula of the universal gravitational constant G is:
Answer: [M⁻¹ L³ T⁻²]

Q8. Which quantity is dimensionless: refractive index, force, mass, pressure?
Answer: Refractive index

Q9. When two quantities have identical dimensions but different meaning, dimensional analysis:
Answer: cannot distinguish them (e.g. work and torque)

Q10. Order of magnitude of the Sun–Earth distance (1.5 × 10¹¹ m) is:
Answer: 10¹¹ m
